name: leave_of_absence_policy
description: Defines eligibility, duration limits, application method, and paid leave benefits for leaves of absence.

variables.name: hours_per_week
variables.description: The requester's working hours per week. Full-time eligibility requires more than 20 hours per week.

variables.name: consecutive_calendar_days
variables.description: The number of consecutive calendar days requested for this leave.

variables.name: has_manager_approval
variables.description: Whether a manager approved an extension beyond 30 consecutive calendar days. This is relevant only when the request exceeds 30 days.

variables.name: submission_method
variables.description: The method used to submit the leave request.

variables.name: recipient_department
variables.description: The department to which the leave request was submitted.

variables.name: is_paid_leave
variables.description: Whether the requester is asking for the leave to be paid.

rules.description: Employees designated full-time and working more than 20 hours per week qualify to request leave.
Part-time employees working 20 hours per week or fewer are ineligible for leave.
A leave request exceeding 30 consecutive calendar days is not allowed without manager approval.
A leave request must be submitted by email.
A leave request must be submitted to the HR department.
Paid leave is available only to employees designated full-time and working more than 20 hours per week.
rules.condition: is_paid_leave == true AND employment_status == "full_time" AND hours_per_week > 20

rules.description: Part-time employees are not eligible for paid leave.
Contractors are not eligible for paid leave.

examples.question: Can I request 10 consecutive calendar days of leave?
examples.explanation: The requester is full-time, works more than 20 hours per week, is within the 30-day limit, and submits the request by email to HR.

examples.question: Can I request 35 consecutive calendar days of leave without manager approval?
examples.explanation: The request exceeds 30 consecutive calendar days and does not have manager approval.

examples.question: Can a contractor request paid leave?
examples.explanation: Contractors are ineligible for leave and are not eligible for paid leave.

examples.question: Can I submit my leave request verbally at the office?
examples.explanation: Leave requests must be submitted by email; verbal requests are not acceptable.
